text:
mika: quick sync — after last night's canary spill, we should author a short runbook + console controls for telemetry-driven autofallbacks. who owns the signals and the default behavior? :eyes:

jared: yep. i can draft signals. proposal: p95 latency, error-rate 5xx > 1%, model token rejection rate, and queue length. if any two trigger within 2m -> autofallback.

priya: agree on signals. add tail-latency (p99) for long tails. also include kv-cache miss rate because that spiked and amplified latency.

luca: from SRE POV we need region-aware thresholds. a small zone outage can spike global error-rate but shouldn't trigger global fallback. prefer per-region evaluation with a global arbitration step.

ben: console/UX note — product teams want a simple dropdown: "fallback precedence" with options (model-variant, region-first, capacity-hedge). advanced mode should let you reorder and add cooldowns.

mika: good. defaults: prefer model-variant first, regional failover second, capacity fallback last? thoughts on ordering and safety?

jared: i'd put capacity fallback before regional failover for low-latency apps — run in-region but to cheaper instance types with quantized models. region failover adds cross-region latency.

priya: runtime supports multi-variant routes. capacity fallback needs kernel/quantization hints. we'll need a quick compatibility matrix surfaced in the Console when you pick a fallback chain.

luca: also add a "grace window": only enable autofallback after N failed canary minutes OR manual ack. otherwise noisy flapping.

rollout-bot: [alert] canary 202-rc3: 3m spike p95+error -> autofallback triggered in eu-west-1 -> model v2 -> v1.

mika: that bot message is exactly the telemetry we want in the runbook. step 1: notification -> auto-switch reason showed in console -> step 2: roll back if quality regressions detected -> step 3: on-call ack.

ben: UX mock idea:

```
Fallback chain (default): [Model variant -> Capacity -> Region]
- Model variant: fallback-to: v1, cooldown: 5m
- Capacity: alt-profile: cpu-optimized-quant, max-degradation: 20%
- Region: failover-regions: [eu-central-1, us-west-2]
```

show telemetry panel with last-triggered metric and small "why" card.

priya: can we have a compact JSON policy for infra to consume? e.g.:

```
{
  "policy_id":"canary-autofb-1",
  "signals":["p95_latency","error_rate","kv_miss"],
  "trigger_rule":">=2_signals_in_120s",
  "chain":["model_variant","capacity","region"],
  "cooldowns":{"model_variant":300}
}
```

runtime can ingest that and emit telemetry -> rollout-bot.

jared: looks good. need one more field: "scope": "per-region|global" and "min_traffic_pct" to avoid tiny canaries flipping things.

luca: also append a safety leash: max 1 autofallback per 30m unless manual override. and an opt-out label for experiments.

mika: action items: jared draft signals doc + sample policy (due EOD), ben sketch console dropdown and "why" panel (tomorrow AM), priya add runtime ingestion stub and compatibility matrix (EOW), luca draft SRE leash + incident play in runbook (EOD).

deploy-bot: deploy:canary-autofb-policy v0.1 applied to staging at 2051234800 by jared

mika: perfect — i'll collate into a short runbook and link to the console mock. thanks all :thumbsup:
